Academic layer: No current events, no next events. All classrooms are empty. Aggregate has current_events as empty. So no academic activity happening right now.

Social layer: No collaboration, energy, or interactions. All rooms are inactive. 

Cross-room patterns: All rooms are unoccupied, but only two have active rooms (maybe sensors on). The average temperature is given despite most readings missing. The campus is quiet, with no academic or social activity. Nighttime, so low occupancy is expected. Possible anomaly: some rooms have temperature data but no CO2, which might mean sensors are partially functioning.

Synthesizing into a poetic overview: Present the campus as a still organism, with only a few sensors active, the average temperature, and emphasize the lack of activity at night.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>The campus hums with silence as 17 rooms lie dormant, their occupancy at zero, yet a ghostly 22.3°C lingers in the air, while silent sensors whisper of no CO2; no minds stir, no events ignite, save for flickers of unmeasured hums in vacant halls. Below the night’s stillness, every room is empty—no lecture, no laughter, no light—only the cold, collective breath
